title: 第154章 领主和附属民
slug: 求生游戏请叫我诚信商人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

郝师：“我和欧皇决定选自由民和附属民，你呢？”

李知：“我还没看，我看一眼。”

她首先查看的是领主的详情。

【领主：仅限排行榜前100名的玩家选择】

【领主任务详情：领主/临时领主将要以扩建领地、加强设施、招募属民、对抗外敌等作为主线任务，成功完成任务将获得与领地建设相关的奖励；任务失败则可能失去部分领地、建筑、附属民资格证】

李知又查看了自由民和附属民的详情。

【自由民：所有玩家都可选择】

【自由民任务详情：自由民将以升级载具/庇护所为主线任务，成功完成任务将获得载具/庇护所相关奖励；任务失败则可能失去载具/庇护所】

【附属民：所有玩家都可选择】

【附属民任务详情：附属民以获得附属民资格为主线任务，跟随领主/临时领主进行领主任务，成功完成任务将根据贡献度发放奖励；任务失败则有可能失去附属民身份】

【注1：附属民和自由民可自由转变】

【注2：当附属民被任意领地驱逐次数达到三次，将失去附属民和自由民资格】

李知看完之后，没怎么犹豫就选择了“领主”和“自由民”任务。

她本来也要扩张领地和升级飞舟，这两条任务线路和她的目标重合，是最适合她选择的任务路线。

【玩家还我三星五费！！！生存模式选择完毕：领主/自由民】

【主线任务将在23:56:33之后发布】

对话框出现在眼前，李知的视线却停留在“失去附属民和自由民资格”这个几个字上。

如果一个人失去了附属民和自由民资格，同时这个人也不是领主，那么这个人会面临什么？

她不由想起绒族的处境。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Master Hao: "Emperor Ou and I have decided to choose free citizens and dependent people. What about you?"

Li Zhi: "I haven't looked at it yet. I'll take a look."

The first thing she checked was the lord's details.

[Lord: Only the top 100 players on the leaderboard can choose]

[Lord mission details: The lord/temporary lord will expand the territory, strengthen facilities, recruit subjects, fight against foreign enemies, etc. as the main tasks. Successfully completing the task will receive rewards related to territory construction; if the task fails, you may lose part of the territory, buildings, and subject qualification certificates]

Li Zhi checked the details of free people and dependent people.

[Free Folk: All players can choose]

[Freemen mission details: Freemen will upgrade vehicles/shelters as the main task. Successfully completing the mission will obtain vehicle/shelter related rewards; if the mission fails, you may lose the vehicle/shelter]

[Subjects: All players can choose]

[Details of subject tasks: Subjects obtain subject qualifications as the main task, and follow the lord/temporary lord to carry out lord tasks. Successful completion of the task will award rewards based on contribution; failure of the task may result in loss of subject status]

[Note 1: Subject subjects and free subjects can be freely transformed]

[Note 2: When a subject is expelled from any territory three times, he will lose his qualifications as a subject and a free citizen]

After Li Zhi read it, he chose the "Lord" and "Free People" tasks without much hesitation.

She originally wanted to expand her territory and upgrade her flying boat. These two mission routes coincided with her goals and were the most suitable mission routes for her to choose.

[The player returned me three stars and five fees!!!Survival mode selected: Lord/Free Folk]

[The main mission will be released after 23:56:33]

The dialog box appeared in front of him, but Li Zhi's eyes stayed on the words "lost the qualifications of subject and free citizen".

If a person loses his status as a vassal and freeman, and is not a lord, what will this person face?

She couldn't help but think of the situation of the Velvet people.
